violated_contract: A pendant question must terminate even if native spoken-output setup or cleanup never completes. Optional audio feedback must not strand tutorial Processing or retain the voice busy guard, and delayed cleanup must not stop a newer response.
canonical_prevention: Bound playback admission and revoke late admission after timeout; complete request failures independently of best-effort, request-scoped audio cleanup. Fence cleanup by the admitted playback lifecycle, not the begin-attempt counter: mode-off, missing-headphone and revoked-admission skips must leave existing cleanup intact, while an admitted replacement must be protected from old cleanup.
